subject: Scaled coordinates and units of density estimate

messages.author: 2af3e548f96847c2
messages.subject: Scaled coordinates and units of density estimate
parts:
Hi all,

I’m having a tough time determining the units for my density estimates from predict(). I understand secr reports density estimates in animals/hectare. If I scaled all coordinates from meters to km (divided them by 1,000) prior to analysis, would this still be the case? My instinct is to divide my estimate (0.627) by 10,000 (the conversion from hectares to square meters), but that gives me a small number (0.00000627) that doesn’t make sense with my abundance estimate (2,384) and area (~6,000 sq. km).

Apologies if this has been answered, I tried searching through documentation and previous posts first.

Thanks,

Jennifer E. Nelson, MSc

jennife...@gmail.com
